Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness.
